subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan - FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: James O'Connor <j.oconnor@finservcorp.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap & proposed POC plan - FinServCorp

Hi James / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get a short POC running so your team can validate latency, cost, and output quality on your core workflows.

Recap from today's call:
- Use case: fraud-investigation assistant for analyst workflows (query + summarize + embeddings search).
- Key constraints: PII redaction, on-prem data connectivity to their case DB, 95th pct token latency target < 600ms for short queries.
- Success metrics you mentioned:
  - Precision/recall on entity extraction >= 90% vs. labeled set
  - Median latency <= 400ms for 10k token budget scenario
  - Cost per 1k tokens <= target you gave (we'll align once you share your monthly volume estimate)

Proposed 3-week POC (high level):
1) Week 0 (prep, 2 business days): access & infra checklist, sign mutual action plan, share security/compliance intake.
2) Week 1 (integration): connect a sample dataset (S3 or secure FTP), configure model variant + quantization profile, baseline runs.
3) Week 2 (evaluation): run eval prompts (we'll supply an initial eval suite), capture latency/cost, iterate prompts + batching.
4) Week 3 (wrap): deliver results, handoff runbook and recommended config for production.

Proposed timeline & owners:
- Kickoff: week of Nov 30 (target) — owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) + Priya (FinServCorp)
- Infra & access: owner: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood SE) + FinServ security contact
- Evaluation lead: FinServ analytics (James) + Redwood SE (Rishi)

Attachments: FinServ_POC_Scope_v1.pdf (scope & MOP), Demo_Record.mp4 (screen capture). Also attaching a starter success criteria sheet (POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx) in follow-up.

Ask from you: can you confirm:
1) That Nov 30 kickoff window could work for your team?
2) Who should be the primary technical contact for infra/security access?
3) Any must-have success gates beyond the three metrics above?

I'll loop in Laura from my manager side if we need approval on carved pricing for a POC.

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed POC plan - FinServCorp

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Timeline: Nov 30 kickoff looks possible, but our infra/security lead is out Nov 26-29. Would it be possible to do a lightweight kickoff (intro + access plan) on Nov 30 and defer deep infra tasks to the week of Dec 7?

2) Technical contact: I'll be primary for analytics, but our security owner will be Mark Rivera (m.rivera@finservcorp.com). I'll loop him in on this thread.

3) Success gates: add one more — end-to-end PII redaction validation: we need to see automated PII redaction on sample documents with a false-negative rate < 2%.

4) Compliance ask: can you share SOC2 and data retention policy artifacts ahead of the kickoff? Our procurement will want to review before we approve data access.

Also attaching our preferred sample dataset format and a short internal checklist we run for POCs (I can share once Mark is on thread).

Thanks — James
